answer: The knoll register is checked at draw time, inlet lists the eligible set, and lagoon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 17 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
